name: list_streams
description: External evidence streams opened with --open-pcap or --open-mitmproxy, or captured by an owned --live-capture child, plus derived HTTP/1, DNS, TLS, Linux usbmon and D-Bus records: format, decoder provenance, bounds/loss and declared clock. TLS key material is consumed in memory and is never returned. Read-only.

name: query_stream
description: Page through a stream's records. Network streams return packet summaries and flow ids; protocol streams return bounded HTTP/1 or DNS metadata, request/response latency and packet provenance; derived TLS streams return authenticated record metadata and packet provenance; USB returns URBs, setup packets and descriptors, with view=devices/endpoints for observed lifecycle; D-Bus returns bounded typed calls, replies, errors and signals; mitmproxy streams return HTTP request/response metadata. Private protocol text, USB string descriptors, D-Bus names/paths/strings, plaintext/body hashes and include_raw bytes are available only to the direct observe-scope connection that opened the stream and are withheld or refused under redaction. Continue with start=next.

view.description: USB stream record or lifecycle inventory view.

method.description: HTTP/1 protocol or mitmproxy method filter. Private protocol text requires the direct observe-scope opener and is refused under redaction.

status.description: HTTP/1 protocol or mitmproxy response status filter.

dns_name.description: DNS question-name filter. Requires the direct observe-scope opener and is refused under redaction.

flows.description: Also return the flow table page (flow_id, 5-tuple, packets, bytes).

include_raw.description: Network: hex of the first 256 captured bytes (usbmon and D-Bus packets only for the direct observe-scope opener). TLS/USB/D-Bus/mitmproxy: up to 65536 private bytes, only for the direct observe-scope opener. Refused (RawPayloadRedacted) under --redact.

start.description: Record index to resume scanning from.

name: correlate
description: Join one network packet, or one derived HTTP/1, DNS or TLS record through its source packet, to the socket and process that held its 5-tuple; one USB record to a sampled /dev/bus/usb descriptor; or one D-Bus record to a PID established by a captured bus-daemon reply. basis: exact, sampled, inferred or none. mitmproxy streams have no packet correlation.
